name: Arjun Mk1 / Mk1A
armament: 120 mm rifled gun (fires LAHAT ATGM on Mk1A)
protection: Kanchan composite armour, ERA on Mk1A. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Very large slab-sided boxy turret with a flat front
Seven road wheels per side, side skirts
Mk1A: ERA panels on the turret and hull front, remote weapon station, track width mine plough option
Deployed mainly in the Rajasthan desert sector
